According to [[Reading/Clipped - GT2 belt tension]], the recommended belt tension is **3.5 kg** (measured with a luggage scale) for a 6 mm GT2 belt on a desktop gantry.

You should re-check the tension after the first ten hours of printing, as new belts stretch.
